The pure rigid camera transform and half-pixel index convention are correct. The fixed preclose references, all 1968 tracks / 91512 rows, 186 capture summaries and denominator 492 are preserved, with all four metrics and underlying vectors retained.

A clean exact commit, pinned locateanything Python/NumPy runtime and fixed new output directory gate the sole batch. Complete outputs are sealed before any later report joins old 3D summaries; partial output and failure counters are retained without retry.
